title: Flood water entering village homes near river
solution: Built elevated walkway and improved drainage system with community's civil engineering department
outcome: Reduced flooding impact by 70%, 45 families protected

title: Crop pest destroying paddy fields
solution: Developed low-cost bio-pesticide with agricultural university and distributed to 200 farmers

title: Drinking water contamination causing illness
solution: Installed community filtration units after water testing by environmental science department
outcome: Illness cases reduced by 80%, 1200 people benefited
